findings.summary: Declared security patch postdates the compile timestamp of the same partition
findings.detail: Partition system declares security patch 2026-07-05, which is 670 days later than that partition's own build timestamp. An image cannot contain a patch published after it was compiled; only a single bulletin cycle of forward declaration is legitimate.

findings.summary: Device claims a locked, verified boot state while advertising Widevine L1 with no provisioned credential
findings.detail: The device reports verifiedbootstate=green and flash.locked=1, and its Widevine plugin advertises L1, but the plugin reports the unprovisioned-system-ID placeholder and could not open a provisioned session. L1 key material is erased when the bootloader is unlocked and cannot be restored from userspace, so these two statements cannot both be true.

findings.summary: One Keystore key returned different certificate chains through the alias path and the grant path
findings.detail: The same key was read twice, by alias and through a grant issued to this application's own uid, and the two chains disagree at index 0 (leaf_certificate). A stored chain is identical to every reader, so a difference means the chain is being produced per lookup rather than returned from storage.
